message:
I have a little confession: I might be a tad over-prepared when it comes to power outages. The last time the lights flickered, I was ready with my trusty flashlights, a couple of lanterns, and yes, even a fully charged power bank. I set up a cozy little glow in the living room and we ended up having the most delightful game night, complete with snacks from the fridge (thank you, portable cooler!). 

Sometimes, being overly ready can turn a potential inconvenience into a fun family memory. So if you ever find yourself in the dark, don’t forget that a bit of preparation can keep the good vibes flowing! What’s your favorite tip for staying comfortable during a blackout? 😄
